name: AppleHud
summary: Makes a library UI kit show the game: money, wave, countdown, base health and messages in the kit's own labels, and the kit's shop filled with this game's items (each shown as its 3D model).

needs.kit: A library UI kit's screens in StarterGui.
needs.config: ReplicatedStorage.AppleComponents.AppleClientConfig: { currency, ui = { money, wave, timer, base, baseBar, message, shopButton, shopPanel, shopClose, shopList, shopCard } (dotted paths under PlayerGui), words = { wave, nextWave, left, base, lost, pick } }

gives.labels: the kit's labels show live values; a role left out is found by name when it can be
gives.shop: one card per item cloned from the kit's own card: name, price, the item's 3D model; pressing it starts placing

limits: It never creates panels. Screens and labels the game does not use are hidden by the composer, not here.
